NOTE_TIMING: This declared set has still never run. What is known about this RTL comes from the bring-up set, whose run at the 30.0 ns gate, RUN_2026-11-09_21-14-43, closed eight of nine corners and missed max_ss_100C_1v60 by 0.4906 ns over 35 register to register paths while leaving the typical corners at +14.4 to +15.5 ns and the fast ones at +20.1 to +20.9 ns. Hold stayed negative in seven corners, worst -0.1540 ns, all of them [hold in-reg] input port paths, because the Classic flow repairs hold with global-route parasitics at OpenROAD.ResizerTimingPostGRT and never again after OpenROAD.DetailedRouting: the same corner read +0.1002 ns right after that resizer and -0.0585 ns at signoff on the extracted parasitics, a gap of about 0.16 ns. PL_RESIZER_HOLD_SLACK_MARGIN and GRT_RESIZER_HOLD_SLACK_MARGIN, default 0.10 and 0.05 ns in the installed 2.3.10, are set to 0.40 ns here so the resizer overfixes hold. SETUP_VIOLATION_CORNERS and HOLD_VIOLATION_CORNERS cover all nine corners instead of the *tt* pattern the sky130 compatibility layer installs by default. At the 4.0 ns of this file the same layout was 15.72 ns short in the slow corner when it was constrained to 8.0 ns, so 4.0 ns is an aspiration and not a result. See doc/verification_report.md for the measured tables.
NOTE_ANTENNA: The antenna problem the first complete run of 2026-11-09 reported, 54 antenna pin violations on 46 nets with worst ratio 5.20 and only 468 diode cells inserted, is closed: the bring-up run RUN_2026-11-09_21-14-43 printed Antenna Passed in Misc.ReportManufacturability with an empty violation table from OpenROAD.CheckAntennas after detailed routing. What made the difference is that the knobs below are spelled with OpenLane 2 names and DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY is absent, because OpenLane 2 maps the OpenLane 1 number and then overwrites RUN_HEURISTIC_DIODE_INSERTION and DIODE_ON_PORTS from it. The cost of the fix is measured too: 16898 instances of class antenna_cell, die area 393012 square micrometres against 350447 before, and standard cell area 204806 against 169306. HEURISTIC_ANTENNA_THRESHOLD 60 is aggressive and 90 is the looser setting; either way the antenna report of the run is what decides, not this file.
NOTE_OPENLANE_VERSION: Keys are OpenLane 1 flow.tcl names, which OpenLane 2 keeps in its Classic flow. The bring-up set ran end to end on 2026-11-09 with openlane 2.3.10 in a container: all 78 steps of the Classic flow ran, a GDSII was written, and the flow exited non zero on deferred setup and hold errors in the three tt corners. This declared set at 4.0 ns has never run: at the measured 8.0 ns the same RTL was 4.44 ns short in the typical corner and 15.72 ns short in the slow one, so 4.0 ns is an aspiration and not a result. QUIT_ON_TIMING_VIOLATIONS and RUN_CVC are gone because openlane 2.3.10 has no such keys, and QUIT_ON_LINTER_ERRORS became ERROR_ON_LINTER_ERRORS. PNR_SDC_FILE and SIGNOFF_SDC_FILE name the same constraint file as SDC. See doc/build_instructions.md and doc/verification_report.md.
NOTE_PATHS: A dir:: token resolves to the directory holding this config file, so the RTL sources are referenced one level up, in asic_chip/rtl. tests/test_asic_compiler.py expands every dir:: entry and fails if the named file is missing, which keeps this list honest without running the flow.
NOTE_ROM: The instruction memory is a 128 by 32 bit read only array initialized in an initial block. Yosys realizes it as constant logic in this flow; production would replace it with a hard ROM macro.
NOTE_DEBUG_PORTS: LL_DEBUG_PORTS is deliberately undefined here, so the dbg_ port group does not exist in the synthesized netlist and no package pin is reserved for it.
